mapper.select: SELECT am.uid , am.account_id , am.company_name , am.service_code , am.password , am.password_reset_date , am.freepass_ip , am.allow_msg_notify , am.lounge_code , am.lounge_name , am.lounge_uid , am.on_service , am.user_name , am.phone_num , am.email_address , am.is_encrypted , am.enc_data , am.memo , am.reg_date , am.update_date , ( SELECT ARRAY_AGG(m.group_code || ':' || amp.api_code) FROM api_menu_permission amp JOIN api_menu m ON amp.api_code = m.code AND m.on_service = '${@com.theloungemembers.core.type.ServiceStatus@IN_SERVICE.code}' WHERE amp.account_id = am.account_id AND amp.on_service = '${@com.theloungemembers.core.type.ServiceStatus@IN_SERVICE.code}' ) AS allowed_menu_codes FROM api_member am WHERE am.uid = #{uid}

SELECT am.uid , am.account_id , am.company_name , am.service_code , am.password , am.password_reset_date , am.freepass_ip , am.allow_msg_notify , am.lounge_code , am.lounge_name , am.lounge_uid , am.on_service , am.user_name , am.phone_num , am.email_address , am.is_encrypted , am.enc_data , am.memo , am.reg_date , am.update_date FROM api_member am WHERE am.account_id = #{accountId}

SELECT am.uid , am.account_id , am.company_name , am.service_code , am.password , am.password_reset_date , am.freepass_ip , am.allow_msg_notify , am.lounge_code , am.lounge_name , am.lounge_uid , am.on_service , am.user_name , am.phone_num , am.email_address , am.is_encrypted , am.enc_data , am.memo , am.reg_date , am.update_date , ( SELECT ARRAY_AGG(m.group_code || ':' || amp.api_code) FROM api_menu_permission amp JOIN api_menu m ON amp.api_code = m.code AND m.on_service = '${@com.theloungemembers.core.type.ServiceStatus@IN_SERVICE.code}' WHERE amp.account_id = am.account_id AND amp.on_service = '${@com.theloungemembers.core.type.ServiceStatus@IN_SERVICE.code}' ) AS allowed_menu_codes FROM api_member am

where.if: AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM api_menu_permission amp WHERE amp.account_id = am.account_id AND amp.api_code = #{apiMenuCode} AND amp.on_service = '${@com.theloungemembers.core.type.ServiceStatus@IN_SERVICE.code}' )
